svg.text: set screws on the flat + key
chuck adapter 302 on stub spigot: slides 12
1. Rail seat bar 106 is faced after welding: flat 0.05 over 500, parallel to the column 0.1. Block face B is machined after the carriage is welded.
2. The chuck floats 12 [.47] against a light spring so it lands softly on the loose cap; torque passes through the set screw in the slot, not the spring.
3. Clutch set per cap (S 1.6, J 2.5 N·m) with the torque tester P1-402; motor stall torque 4.4 N·m is above the highest setting.
